title: atlax PUBLISHED stamp (artifacts/<artifact>/PUBLISHED)
description: The stamp `atlax publish` writes into an artifact's folder in the atlax repo: four `key: value` lines (a YAML mapping; sha and time quoted), saying which main of which repo the folder was copied from, when, and by which factory. Publishing the same sha twice is a no-op; the newer main wins. Writer: `atlax publish` (run by atlax-agent's watcher). Readers: `atlax check`, atlax-agent's freshness report (folder sha equals main's), Deltagos and Elenx (the source of what they draw). The published folder sample is published/agent-slack/: PUBLISHED, plant.yaml, elements/ (copies of the artifact's atlax/elements/), derived/map.json (c4-map/1, contracts/c4-map/map.schema.json, written by `c4-map gen` at that sha).

sha.description: The main commit the folder was copied and derived from. Quoted: an all-digit sha would read as a number.

time.description: When it was published, UTC. Quoted: unquoted, a YAML reader makes it a timestamp.
